scripts.dev:free-ports: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; function Kill-Port($port){ try{ $own = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; foreach($pid in $own){ try{ Stop-Process -Id $pid -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {} try{ & cmd.exe /c taskkill /PID $pid /F /T 1>$null 2>$null } catch {} } } catch {} ; try{ $lines = & cmd.exe /c netstat -ano ^| findstr :$port; foreach($l in $lines){ $t=($l -replace '\s+',' ').Trim().Split(' '); $pid=$t[$t.Length-1]; if($pid -match '^[0-9]+$'){ try{ Stop-Process -Id $pid -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {} try{ & cmd.exe /c taskkill /PID $pid /F /T 1>$null 2>$null } catch {} } } } catch {} }; Kill-Port 5174; Kill-Port 5175; Kill-Port 1430; Kill-Port 1420; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 400; exit 0"
scripts.dev:prepare: bun run dev:free-ports && bun run dev
scripts.fix:rs: cd src-tauri && cargo fmt && cargo fix --allow-dirty --allow-staged
